source.description:
PROBLEM
scripts/e5-packaged-plugin-e2e.mjs is the only end-to-end check of the artifact a release
ships, and it cannot run in CI: it invokes the real `claude` binary in six places
(--version, plugin validate --strict, --plugin-dir ... mcp list), and GitHub runners have no
Claude Code CLI. Wiring it in was attempted on 2026-09-12 and reverted — every
claude-dependent check failed with exit=undefined.

So the harness runs only when a human remembers. The cost is measured: when use_specialist
was deleted in #342 the harness went red and nothing reported it for a day. It was found by
hand while verifying an unrelated change.

The checks split cleanly by what they need:

  CLIENT-dependent (need the claude binary):
    [load] claude plugin validate --strict
    [claude-live-load], [client-connected], [client-tools], [client-skill]
  RUNNER-executable (need only node/bun and npm):
    pack and scratch-install the tarball
    the raw MCP handshake against plugins/specialists/scripts/mcp-server.mjs
    tools/list over that handshake  <- THE ONE THAT ACTUALLY DRIFTED
    the wake-watch hook contract
    status payload shape and byte budget
    repo-file exclusion from the scratch install

The drift that bit us was the tool list, and that is observable from the raw MCP handshake
without any client.

SUCCESS
The runner-executable checks run on every PR. The client-dependent ones stay manual and say
so when skipped, rather than silently reporting green.

SCOPE
scripts/e5-packaged-plugin-e2e.mjs and .github/workflows/tests.yml.

NON_GOALS
Do not install or stub the claude binary in CI to force the client checks. A stub would
assert against our own fake rather than the client, which is the one thing those checks
exist to avoid.
Do not delete the client-dependent checks. They cover what a user actually sees and are the
reason the harness is worth running at all.

CONSTRAINTS
A skipped check must report as SKIP with its reason, never as PASS. Absence of a failure is
not a pass, and this repo has been bitten by exactly that shape of silence.
The split must not let the two halves disagree about the expected tool list — one source for
that expectation, consumed by both.

VALIDATION
- On a runner with no claude binary: the runner-executable checks run, the rest report SKIP
  with a reason, exit code reflects only the checks that ran.
- Locally with claude present: full run, unchanged behaviour, RESULT: PASS.
- Remove a tool from the surface and confirm the CI-runnable half goes red.
source.title: Split the packaged-plugin E2E so a runner can execute the part that drifts
